prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Render one complete, high fidelity native Android phone screen for a Nikon preset app, edge to edge in a tall portrait 9:20 aspect ratio, no handset, no desktop frame. This is a DESIGN PROPOSAL, not a running app. Ordinary Chinese-speaking photographers browse preset photographs, download an NCP, then import it by USB. Keep the hierarchy as usable as a polished native Android app.

Direction A, clear catalog. A near-white and very pale warm-grey ground, dark charcoal Chinese system sans-serif, restrained deep vermilion red for the active tab and main controls, stable opaque surfaces. A signature repeated caption line keeps each preset name adjacent to its download state. No serif display, no artificial texture or glass.

The first viewport contains an Android status bar, compact title “预设库”, subtle help icon, two native peer tabs “在线预设” and “我的预设”, and a clearly labeled secondary action “从手机添加”. A compact connection row says “未连接相机” with supporting text “浏览与下载不受影响”. The photo-first vertical list shows two large landscape sample photographs and the beginning of the next item. First synthetic entry “晴日胶片”, “未下载”, a softly sunlit coastal street photograph. Second “青山淡彩”, “已下载”, a green mountain and river photograph. Caption metadata is quiet and readable, download controls recognizable. No search, invented ratings, accounts, shopping, favorites or filters. Each image has a small honest label “概念样片”. Bottom Android gesture safe area. Small caption “界面设计示意 · 非预设实拍” remains legible. Chinese labels must be sharp and exact; spacious but not wasteful, consistent native touch targets.
